name: spi_i2c
description: ST's HAL SPI and I2C masters against the catalog's EEPROMs. SPI2 (mode 0, 36 MHz / 16 = 2.25 MHz) to a 25LC040: WREN sets its latch (status 02), WRITE of six bytes, RDSR polled through its 5 ms write cycle, READ returns them; 687 bytes in all, 16 SCK edges each, after SCK's one from Z to its idle 0 as SPE sets. I2C1 (100 kHz, 4.7 kOhm pull-ups) to a 24C02 at 0x50: HAL_I2C_Mem_Write, HAL_I2C_IsDeviceReady NACKed through its 5 ms write cycle, then HAL_I2C_Mem_Read of one, two (POS) and five bytes, and 0x51 unanswered.

expect.contains: spi: status 02 after WREN, write cycle over after 334 polls, read EmbSIM

i2c: write ok
i2c: ready again after 5 ms (27 NACKs)
